_why: Q.5's whole stem is a picture, and the picture carries chemistry that appears NOWHERE in the chapter's prose — most importantly the cathodic half-reaction producing hydroxide ions, which the diagram prints and the text on printed p44 does not (the prose gives only the half-reaction producing water). The labels and equations are drawn as vector text PyMuPDF cannot see, so audit-grounding.ts would otherwise report every one of them as an unsourced claim. Read off the rendered page at 5x and attributed to the figure they come from, so a genuine invention still stands out.
